'''Brick ovens''' can create [[brick]]s of ''any'' color, particularly useful for [[cv:megaprojects|megaprojects]]. One [[stone]] boulder creates 4 [[brick]]s (similar to [[cv:block|block]]s in vanilla DF), and two stones create four [[fine brick]]s, which are more valuable. Brick ovens ''do not'' require [[fuel]] of any kind.

Bricks can be created in all 16 [[cv:color|color]]s used in DF, including black.
